summary: Cantor Equity Partners III, Inc. (CAEP), a SPAC, filed an 8-K Item 1.01 disclosing a Forward Purchase Agreement entered on May 11, 2026 with Harraden Circle entities (Seller) in connection with its pending business combination with AIR Limited. Under the agreement, the Seller will purchase up to 5,000,000 Class A ordinary shares from CAEP’s trust account at the per-share redemption price for a prepaid aggregate cash amount. The Seller may terminate the transaction on any exchange business day after closing, in whole or in part for blocks of at least 5,000 shares. This provides financing to ensure trust account funds remain available at closing. Watch for regulatory approval and shareholder vote on the de-SPAC merger.
